Gate altercation and approach-road protest accounts may describe related stages, but identical cohorts, uninterrupted continuity and the exact first reopening are not established. Numeric duration remains withheld. The additional August 8 accounts are available as substantive indexed extracts, and the August 9 Libya Observer and August 12 LANA accounts were read in full. Phase geography remains unlocated in the existing phase table.
